overview: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn provided updates on the city's summer recreational offerings, ongoing road maintenance across 150 streets, and the status of several park renovation projects.

items.title: Recreation and Programming Updates
items.summary: The Mayor announced the completion of the Wright's Pond mural and provided schedules for summer park programs and movie nights at Tufts Park and Wright's Pond.

items.title: Street Maintenance and Infrastructure
items.summary: The city is beginning patchwork and crack sealing on approximately 150 streets, following recently completed work on Lawrence Road.

items.title: Park Improvement Projects
items.summary: Updates were provided for several park projects, including groundbreakings at Gillis and Carr parks and scheduled completions for Morrison and Hickey parks through August and September.

items.title: Riverside Avenue Repaving
items.summary: Milling and paving work on Riverside Avenue is expected to start next week, though the Mayor noted that recent rain has caused some schedule delays for city projects.
